# Ferguson's Painting & Cleaning, Inc.

> Owner-operated, fully insured painting and home-repair company serving Orlando and Central Florida since 2012. Derwin Ferguson personally handles exterior and interior painting, stucco and drywall repair, popcorn ceiling removal, wood rot and siding repair, fascia and soffit repair, pressure washing, carpentry, pool decks, bathroom remodeling, HOA or POA repaints and vacation-rental turnarounds.

Key facts:
- Business name: Ferguson's Painting & Cleaning (legal name Ferguson's Painting & Cleaning, Inc.)
- Owner: Derwin Ferguson
- Founded: 2012, Orlando, Florida
- Phone (call, text, or WhatsApp): (321) 202-7225
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/13212027225
- Email: derwin@fergusonspainting.com
- Website: https://fergusonspainting.com
- Hours: open 24 hours Monday through Saturday; closed Sunday
- Service-area business (no walk-in location): Orlando, Kissimmee, Celebration, Reunion, Reunion West and Encore, ChampionsGate, Davenport, Windermere, Lake Butler, Dr. Phillips, Horizon West, Winter Garden, Golden Oak, Winter Park, Maitland, Altamonte Springs, Longwood, Lake Mary, Hunter's Creek
- Residential and commercial work; experience with HOA or POA color approvals and vacation-rental communities
- Preferred paint: Sherwin-Williams; other brands on request
- Estimates: free, written; small jobs can often be priced from photos sent by text or through the quote form
- Languages: the team replies in English. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese speakers are welcome; the site has Spanish (/es/), Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-br/) and Simplified Chinese (/zh/) versions
- Reviews: 4.9 on Google (18 reviews) and 100% recommended on Facebook as of October 2026. Google profile: https://g.page/r/CX8fUKnLzEVMEBM
